svg.title: Skylark match engine
svg.desc: Seven weighted factors: skills 30, experience 18, education 5, eligibility 20, location 12, sponsorship 8, preferences 7. Example: a candidate in India targeting Germany scores 86 on a Berlin listing that offers sponsorship. When the listing says it will not sponsor, eligibility and sponsorship are blocked and the weighted sum of 64 is capped at 35.
